text: Prince Rotolo's elite guard accrued fame in Nordland, where they swept through the braying and puzzled hordes of Beastmen and Northmen like a steel gauntlet.

After his many raids as far as Cathay, twisted Don Estragon let himself be consumed by Tzeentch's corruption. The self-entitled Pariahs fled the accursed company and pledged better conducts, but Chi'an Chi is not done with them.
A wandering congregation of harrimaults, seeking the wisdom and justice of the goddess Verena.
Wandering Strygans, descendants of the ancient bodyguards in Ushoran's empire, driven by a melange of delusions, revenge and pride.
Little did the Imperial Reiksguard suspect that they would be kept at bay by a bunch of tilean knights, during the disorienting battle of Ussingen Woods, near Eilhart.
Sent by the Inquisition to check on Lupio Sunscryer's eccentricity, these watchmen fell instead in the corruption themselves... perhaps even of a Darker Prince than Lupio.
The provincial magisters of the Myrmidian cult are both trained politicians and extraordinary men of war.
These Knights' charge and fervour are so ardent they're said to make dawn rise in the darkest lands.
The Engineer Otho compensates success with crazed stubborness. They say he coats his special cannonballs with a mixture of his own beard hair, but a madman would never do that, would he?
The Cult of Gunndred, God of Rustlers and Blackmail, has been expanding and marauding across the most lawless lands of the Border Princes. Gunnslieb's band is testament to their increased confidence.
A uniquely grim offshoot of the Knights Encarmine, the Forlorn routed the greenskins from Monte Castello in a bloody and desperate sortie.
A design by Leonardo da Miragliano, recovered and more or less optimized, for a crank-powered fighting vehicle whose main strengths are lots of cannons and looking absurd.
The next step in Ugoletti's attempts to improve the Tortoise Tank was using a 'liberated' Solar Engine as a power source for both mobility and on-board artillery.
